an3.129:1.1: āyasmā anuruddho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā anuruddho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an3.129:1.2: idhāhaṃ bhante dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena yebhuyyena passāmi mātugāmaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjamānaṃ
an3.129:1.3: katīhi nu kho bhante dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa kedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjatīti.
an3.129:2.1: tīhi kho anuruddha dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati
an3.129:2.3: idha anuruddha mātugāmo pubbaṇhasamayaṃ maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati majjhantikasamayaṃ issāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati sāyaṇhasamayaṃ kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati
an3.129:2.4: imehi kho anuruddha tīhi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjatīti. 131
